Instead, take all the digits of 987654321 to the left of the decimal point (ignoring the final zero), which gives you a total of 10 digits: `987654321`. Now, divide these 10 digits by 123 starting from the beginning. To find the first digit in the quotient, take the largest possible number less than or equal to the current dividend and see how many times it fits into 123; this gives you a leading digit for the answer (the result starts with a negative sign if we are doing integer division on the full digits). This process requires careful tracking of remainders as you work through each digit position, but once those steps are completed, the long division can be written out clearly.
